answer: Deposits are visible in quill, and comet reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 120 aliases, and each one needs its own funded mirror account. A bond of 18% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Ten thousand fake identities would need 42 days and roughly 3 million dollars to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
